name: weapon-balls-workspace
description: Runs the modules together. Each folder (games/weapon-balls, tournament, party, apps/quiz-of-doom, apps/royale, apps/bracket, apps/letter-brawl) is its own project with its own package.json.

scripts.test: node --test tournament/formats/*.test.ts party/server/*.test.ts apps/quiz-of-doom/shared/*.test.ts apps/royale/shared/*.test.ts apps/royale/server/*.test.ts apps/bracket/server/*.test.ts apps/letter-brawl/server/*.test.ts apps/letter-brawl/shared/*.test.ts games/weapon-balls/src/sim/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: cd tournament && npm run typecheck && cd ../party && npm run typecheck && cd ../apps/quiz-of-doom && npm run typecheck && cd ../royale && npm run typecheck && cd ../bracket && npm run typecheck && cd ../letter-brawl && npm run typecheck
